response.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_running_time FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL AND length >= 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY avg_running_time DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The phrase 'using 112 minutes as the running-time cutoff' is interpreted as a minimum threshold: films with length >= 112 minutes qualify.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is interpreted as a maximum threshold, films with length <= 112 minutes would qualify instead.
alternatives.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_running_time FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL AND length <= 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY avg_running_time DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is interpreted as a maximum threshold, films with length <= 112 minutes would qualify instead.
